verses.geez: ስምዑኬ፡ ነገሥት፡ ወለብዉ፡ ወአእምሩ፡ መኳንንተ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: Hear therefore, O ye kings, and understand; learn, ye that be judges of the ends of the earth.

translations.lxx: Hear therefore, O ye kings, and understand; learn, ye that be judges of the ends of the earth.
translations.ron: Ascultaţi deci, regilor, şi înţelegeţi, luaţi învăţătură, voi, care judecaţi marginile pământului.
translations.grk: Ἀκούσατε οὖν βασιλεῖς καὶ σύνετε, μάθετε δικασταὶ περάτων γῆς.

verses.geez: ወአጽምኡ፡ እለ፡ ትእኅዙ፡ ምድረ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወእለ፡ ትትዔበዩ፡ በብዝኀ፡ አሕዛብ።
verses.translation: Give ear, ye that rule the people, and glory in the multitude of nations.

translations.lxx: Give ear, ye that rule the people, and glory in the multitude of nations.
translations.ron: Băgaţi în urechi, voi cei ce stăpâniţi peste mulţimi şi care vă mândriţi cu mulţimea popoarelor voastre".
translations.grk: Ἐνωτίσασθε οἱ κρατοῦντες πλήθους, καὶ γεγαυρομένοι ἐπὶ ὄχλοις ἐθνῶν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወሀበክሙ፡ እዘዘ፡ ወጽንዕክሙ፡ እምኀበ፡ ልዑል፡ ወውእቱ፡ ዘየሐትት፡ ምግባሪክሙ፡ ወይፈትን፡ ምክረክሙ።
verses.translation: For power is given you of the Lord, and sovereignty from the Highest, who shall try your works, and search out your counsels.

translations.lxx: For power is given you of the Lord, and sovereignty from the Highest, who shall try your works, and search out your counsels.
translations.ron: Pricepeţi că stăpânirea vi s-a dat de la Domnul şi puterea de la Cel Preaînalt, Care va cerceta faptele voastre şi va pune la încercare gândurile voastre.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐδόθη παρὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡ κράτησις ὑμῖν, καὶ ἡ δυναστεία παρὰ ὑψίστου, ὃς ἐξετάσει ὑμῶν τὰ ἔργα, καὶ τὰς βουλὰς διερευνήσει.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እንዘ፡ ላእካነ፡ ጽድቁ፡ አንትሙ፡ እፎኑመ፡ ኢትኴንኑ፡ ፍትሕ፡ ርቱዐ፡ ወኢዓቀብክሙ፡ ሕጎ፡ ወኢሖረክሙ፡ በፍናወ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Because, being ministers of his kingdom, ye have not judged aright, nor kept the law, nor walked after the counsel of God;

translations.lxx: Because, being ministers of his kingdom, ye have not judged aright, nor kept the law, nor walked after the counsel of God;
translations.ron: Fiindcă, deşi dregători ai împărăţiei Lui, n-aţi judecat drept, nici legea n-aţi păzit-o, nici n-aţi umblat după sfatul lui Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ὑπηρέται ὄντες τῆς αὐτοῦ βασιλείας οὐκ ἐκρίνατε ὀρθῶς, οὐδὲ ἐφυλάξατε νόμον, οὐδὲ κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπορεύθητε·

verses.geez: ወያነሥእ፡ ላዕሌክሙ፡ ድንጋፄ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ዘይትቃወመክሙ፡ እስመ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ምቱር፡ ለመኳንንት፡ ይከውን።
verses.translation: horribly and speedily shall he come upon you: for a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places.

translations.lxx: horribly and speedily shall he come upon you: for a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places.
translations.ron: Groaznic şi fără de veste El va sta asupra voastră, căci pentru cei mari judecata va fi cumplită.
translations.grk: φρικτῶς καὶ ταχέως ἐπιστήσεται ὑμῖν, ὅτι κρίσις ἀπότομος ἐν τοῖς ὑπερέχουσιν γίνεται.

verses.geez: ወለነዳይሰ፡ ያነሐስዮ፡ ሎቱ፡ እምፍኖተ፡ ምሕረት፡ ወለጽኑዐንሰ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ ሐተታ፡ የሐትትዎሙ።
verses.translation: For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.

translations.lxx: For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.
translations.ron: Celor mici, Domnul le va arăta iertare şi milă, însă cei puternici vor fi pedepsiţi cu străşnicie.
translations.grk: Ὁ γὰρ ἐλάχιστος συγγνωστός ἐστιν ἐλέους, δυνατοὶ δὲ δυνατῶς ἐτασθήσονται·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኢያደሉ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለገጸ፡ ኵሉ፡ ወኢየኃፍር፡ ክብረ፡ ዕበይ፡ እስመ፡ ዓቢየ፡ ወንኡሰ፡ ገብረ፡ ወከማሁ፡ ይሔሊ፡ በእንተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይቀኒ፡ ወዘይትቀነይ፡ ወይሠርዖሙ።
verses.translation: For he which is Lord over all shall fear no man's person, neither shall he stand in awe of any man's greatness: for he hath made the small and great, and careth for all alike.

translations.lxx: For he which is Lord over all shall fear no man's person, neither shall he stand in awe of any man's greatness: for he hath made the small and great, and careth for all alike.
translations.ron: Stăpânul tuturor nu Se va ruşina de nici un obraz, nici nu Se va sfii de vreo mărire, căci şi pe cel mic şi pe cel mare El i-a făcut şi pronia Lui e la fel pentru toţi.
translations.grk: οὐ γὰρ ὑποστελεῖται πρόσωπον ὁ πάντων δεσπότης, οὐδὲ ἐντραπήσεται μέγεθος· ὅτι μικρὸν καὶ μέγαν αὐτὸς ἐποίησεν, ὁμοίως τε προνοεῖ περὶ πάντων.

verses.geez: ወለአዚዛንሰ፡ ኅዩለ፡ ሐተታ፡ ይበጽሖሙ።
verses.translation: But a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.

translations.lxx: But a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.
translations.ron: Însă cei puternici vor avea parte de o încercare mai grea.
translations.grk: Τοῖς δὲ κραταιοῖς ἰσχυρὰ ἐφίσταται ἔρευνα.

verses.geez: ለክሙኬ፡ ነገርየ፡ ኢ፡ መኳንንት፡ እኩያን፡ ወገፋዕያነ፡ ከመ፡ ታእምሩ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወተግሣፀ፡ ወኢትደቁ።
verses.translation: Unto you therefore, O kings, do I speak, that ye may learn wisdom, and not fall away.

translations.lxx: Unto you therefore, O kings, do I speak, that ye may learn wisdom, and not fall away.
translations.ron: Deci către voi, regilor, îndrept cuvintele mele ca să învăţaţi înţelepciune şi să nu cădeţi.
translations.grk: Πρὸς ὑμᾶς οὖν ὦ τύραννοι οἱ λόγοι μου, ἵνα μάθητε σοφίαν καὶ μὴ παραπέσητε.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እለ፡ የአምሩ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወየዓቅቡ፡ በጽድቅ፡ ይጸድቁ፡ ወእለ፡ ተምህርዋ፡ ይረክቡ፡ ምሕረተ።
verses.translation: For they that keep holiness holily shall be judged holy: and they that have learned such things shall find what to answer.

translations.lxx: For they that keep holiness holily shall be judged holy: and they that have learned such things shall find what to answer.
translations.ron: Pentru că cei ce au păzit cu sfinţenie pravila sfântă se vor sfinţi şi cei ce vor învăţa-o vor şti ce să răspundă.
translations.grk: Οἱ γὰρ φυλάξαντες ὁσίως τὰ ὅσια ὁσιωθήσονται, καὶ οἱ διδαχθέντες αὐτὰ εὑρήσουσιν ἀπολογίαν.

verses.geez: ፍትዉኬ፡ እንከ፡ ነገርየ፡ አፍቅርዋ፡ ወተገሠፁ፡ ከመ፡ ትርከቡ፡ ሣህለ፡ ወምሕረተ።
verses.translation: Wherefore set your affection upon my words; desire them, and ye shall be instructed.

translations.lxx: Wherefore set your affection upon my words; desire them, and ye shall be instructed.
translations.ron: Iubiţi deci cuvintele mele şi le doriţi şi vă veţi învăţa din ele.
translations.grk: Ἐπιθυμήσατε οὖν τῶν λόγων μου, ποθήσατε καὶ παιδευθήσεσθε.

verses.geez: ብርህት፡ ይእቲ፡ ጥቀ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወኢይጸመሂ፡ ሥና፡ ወእለ፡ ያፈቅርዋ፡ ይሬእይዋ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ወእለ፡ የኃሥሥዋ፡ ይረክብዋ።
verses.translation: Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: yea, she is easily seen of them that love her, and found of such as seek her.

translations.lxx: Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: yea, she is easily seen of them that love her, and found of such as seek her.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea este luminată şi neînserată şi cei care o iubesc o văd uşor şi cei care o caută o găsesc.
translations.grk: Λαμπρὰ καὶ ἀμάραντός ἐστιν ἡ σοφία, καὶ εὐχερῶς θεωρεῖται ὑπὸ τῶν ἀγαπώντων αὐτήν, καὶ εὑρίσκεται ὑπὸ τῶν ζητούντων αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወትበጽሕ፡ ለእለ፡ ይፈትውዋ፡ ወትትኤመሮሙ፡ ቅድመ።
verses.translation: She preventeth them that desire her, in making herself first known unto them.

translations.lxx: She preventeth them that desire her, in making herself first known unto them.
translations.ron: Ea iese în cale celor care o doresc şi li se arată ea, întâi.
translations.grk: Φθάνει τοὺς ἐπιθυμοῦντας προγνωσθῆναι.

verses.geez: ወዘይገይሥ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ኢይፃሙ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ይረክባ፡ ወትረ፡ እንዘ፡ ትጸንሖ፡ ውሰተ፡ ኆኅቱ።
verses.translation: Whoso seeketh her early shall have no great travail: for he shall find her sitting at his doors.

translations.lxx: Whoso seeketh her early shall have no great travail: for he shall find her sitting at his doors.
translations.ron: Cel care se scoală pentru ea dis-de-dimineaţă nu se va osteni, căci o va afla şezând la poarta lui.
translations.grk: Ὁ ὀρθρίσας ἐπʼ αὐτὴν οὐ κοπιάσει, πάρεδρον γὰρ εὑρήσει τῶν πυλῶν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ሐሊዮ፡ ኪያሃ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ አእምሮ፡ ወዘተግሀ፡ በእንቲአሃ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ትካዝ፡ ይከውን።
verses.translation: To think therefore upon her is the perfection of wisdom: and whoso watcheth for her shall quickly be without care.

translations.lxx: To think therefore upon her is the perfection of wisdom: and whoso watcheth for her shall quickly be without care.
translations.ron: Cel care îşi bate capul cu înţelepciunea îndeplineşte desăvârşirea minţii şi cel care îşi pierde somnul pentru ea va fi în curând fără de grijă.
translations.grk: Τὸ γὰρ ἐνθυμηθῆναι περὶ αὐτῆς φρονήσεως τελειότης, καὶ ὁ ἀγρυπνήσας διʼ αὐτὴν ταχέως ἀμέριμνος ἔσται.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለእለ፡ ይደልውዋ፡ ይእቲ፡ ትመጽእ፡ እንዘ፡ ተኃሥሦሙ፡ ወበውስተ፡ ፍኖትኒ፡ ታስተርእዮሙ፡ ሥእልታ፡ ግብተ፡ አዳመ፡ በኵሉ፡ ሕሊና፡ ትትራከቦሙ።
verses.translation: For she goeth about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably unto them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.

translations.lxx: For she goeth about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably unto them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.
translations.ron: Ea umblă în toate părţile căutând pe cei vrednici de ea şi se arată prietenoasă în drumurile lor şi îi întâmpină în tot ce pun la cale.
translations.grk: Ὅτι τοὺς ἀξίους αὐτῆς αὕτη περιέρχεται ζητοῦσα, καὶ ἐν ταῖς τρίβοις φαντάζεται αὐτοῖς εὐμενῶς, καὶ ἐν πάσῃ ἐπινοίᾳ ὑπαντᾷ αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ተግሣፅ፡ ህልው፡ ውእቱ፡ ፍትወታ፡ ወአስተሐምሞ፡ በተግሣፅ፡ አፍቅሮታ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: For the very true beginning of her is the desire of discipline; and the care of discipline is love;

translations.lxx: For the very true beginning of her is the desire of discipline; and the care of discipline is love;
translations.ron: Începutul ei este pofta cea adevărată de învăţătură.
translations.grk: Ἀρχὴ γὰρ αὐτῆς ἡ ἀληθεστάτη παιδείας ἐπιθυμία, φροντὶς δὲ παιδείας ἀγάπη,

verses.geez: ወአፍቅሮታሂ፡ ዓቂበ፡ ሕገ፡ ዚአሃ፡ ወጠይቆ፡ ኢሙስና፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: and love is the keeping of her laws; and the giving heed unto her laws is the assurance of incorruption;

translations.lxx: and love is the keeping of her laws; and the giving heed unto her laws is the assurance of incorruption;
translations.ron: Iar pofta de învăţătură are în sine iubirea, iar iubirea este paznica legilor ei, iar păzirea legilor ei este adeverirea nemuririi.
translations.grk: ἀγάπη δὲ τήρησις νόμων αὐτῆς, προσοχὴ δὲ νόμων βεβαίωσις ἀφθαρσίας,

verses.geez: ወኢሙስናሂ፡ ትሬሲ፡ ሰብአ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: and incorruption maketh us near unto God:

translations.lxx: and incorruption maketh us near unto God:
translations.ron: Şi nemurirea ne face să fim aproape de Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: ἀφθαρσία δὲ ἐγγὺς εἶναι ποιεῖ Θεοῦ.

verses.geez: ፍትወታኬ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ታዓርግ፡ ኀበ፡ መንግሥት።
verses.translation: therefore the desire of wisdom bringeth to a kingdom.

translations.lxx: therefore the desire of wisdom bringeth to a kingdom.
translations.ron: Drept aceea, pofta înţelepciunii duce la împărăţia cea veşnică.
translations.grk: Ἐπιθυμία ἄρα σοφίας ἀνάγει ἐπὶ βασιλείαν.

verses.geez: እመሰኬ፡ ትፈትዉ፡ መኳንንተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ መናብርተ፡ ወሢመተ፡ መወንግሥተ፡ አክብርዋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ከመ፡ ለዓለም፡ ትንግሡ።
verses.translation: If your delight be then in thrones and sceptres, O ye kings of the people, honour wisdom, that ye may reign for evermore.

translations.lxx: If your delight be then in thrones and sceptres, O ye kings of the people, honour wisdom, that ye may reign for evermore.
translations.ron: Deci dar, o, regi ai popoarelor, dacă ţineţi la tronurile şi la sceptrele voastre, cinstiţi înţelepciunea, ca în veac să domniţi.
translations.grk: Εἰ οὖν ἥδεσθε ἐπὶ θρόνοις καὶ σκήπτροις τύραννοι λαῶν, τιμήσατε σοφίαν, ἵνα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα βασιλεύσητε·

verses.geez: ወምንት፡ ይእቲ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወእፎ፡ ኮነት፡ አነ፡ አየድዐክሙ፡ ወኢየሃብእ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ ምሥጢራቲሃ፡ ክቡተ።
verses.translation: As for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you: but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light, and will not pass over the truth.

translations.lxx: As for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you: but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light, and will not pass over the truth.
translations.ron: Iar ce este înţelepciunea şi cum s-a făcut, sunt gata să vă spun fără să ascund tainele lui Dumnezeu. Ci voi cerceta de la începutul făpturii şi voi da la lumină cunoştinţa ei şi nu voi trece pe alături de adevăr.
translations.grk: Τί δέ ἐστι σοφία καὶ πῶς ἐγένετο, ἀπαγγελῶ, καὶ οὐκ ἀποκρύψω ὑμῖν μυστήρια, ἀλλʼ ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς γενέσεως ἐξιχνιάσω, καὶ θήσω εἰς τὸ ἐμφανὲς τὴν γνῶσιν αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐ μὴ παροδεύσω τὴν ἀλήθειαν·

verses.geez: ወባሕቱ፡ አኃሥሥ፡ እምጥንት፡ ክዋኔሃ፡ ወእሬሲ፡ ክሡተ፡ አእምሮታ፡ ወኢይትዓደው፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወኢየሐውር፡ በቅንአተ፡ ሕመሜ።
verses.translation: Neither will I go with consuming envy; for such a man shall have no fellowship with wisdom.

translations.lxx: Neither will I go with consuming envy; for such a man shall have no fellowship with wisdom.
translations.ron: Nu voi merge pe acelaşi drum cu pizma care roade, căci ea n-are nici o părtăşie cu înţelepciunea.
translations.grk: οὔτε μὴν φθόνῳ τετηκότι συνοδεύσω, ὅτι οὗτος οὐ κοινωνήσει σοφίᾳ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዘከመዝሰ፡ ኢይሳተፋ፡ ለጥበብ፡ እስመ፡ ብዝኅ፡ ጠበብት፡ መድኃኒተ፡ ዓለም፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: But the multitude of the wise is the welfare of the world: and a wise king is the upholding of the people.

translations.lxx: But the multitude of the wise is the welfare of the world: and a wise king is the upholding of the people.
translations.ron: Mulţimea înţelepţilor este mântuirea lumii şi un rege cuminte înseamnă bunăstarea poporului.
translations.grk: Πλῆθος δὲ σοφῶν σωτηρία κόσμου, καὶ βασιλεὺς φρόνιμος εὐστάθεια δήμου.

verses.geez: ወንጉሥ፡ ልብው፡ ቃውም፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ተገሠፁኬ፡ በቃልየ፡ ወትረብኁ።
verses.translation: Receive therefore instruction through my words, and it shall do you good.

translations.lxx: Receive therefore instruction through my words, and it shall do you good.
translations.ron: Drept aceea, luaţi învăţătură din cuvintele mele şi folosul va fi al vostru.
translations.grk: Ὥστε παιδεύεσθε τοῖς ῥήμασί μου, καὶ ὠφεληθήσεσθε.
